title: Stem-cell / clonal haematopoiesis module — scaffold (collaboration starter for Ingmar Glauche)
status: scaffold v0 — anchor edges PubMed-verified; proposed edges to curate with collaborator

edges.rationale: age-related mutational burden in HSCs seeds driver mutations
driver mutations (TET2/DNMT3A/ASXL1/JAK2) in HSCs establish a clone; prevalence rises with age and predicts adverse outcomes
TET2 is a frequent CHIP driver
TET2 normally represses IL-6 (recruits HDAC2); TET2 loss de-represses IL-6 in myeloid cells
Tet2-deficient clonal haematopoiesis raises IL-1b via NLRP3; NLRP3 inhibition abolishes the effect
NLRP3 inflammasome activation processes and releases IL-1b
TET2 CHIP accelerates atherosclerosis via inflammatory myeloid cells; IL-6 blockade alleviates it
inflammatory cytokines (IL-6/TNF) favour mutant-HSC fitness, a feed-forward loop driving clonal expansion
driver mutations confer self-renewal/fitness advantage -> clone grows with age
aged/CHIP HSCs skew toward myeloid output
myeloid skew reduces lymphoid production (immune aging)
preserved adaptive/lymphoid immunity restrains inflammaging; its loss adds to it (links to Aging_inflammation and immune-aging methylation feature)
DNMT3A is the most common CHIP driver
JAK2 V617F drives myeloproliferation (candidate for the inflammation-CHIP loop)

for_glauche: Priorities to co-develop: (1) the clonal-dynamics layer (fitness, expansion rate vs age) where your HSC-modelling expertise is central — the scaffold treats expansion as a single node, but your models could make it quantitative; (2) the inflammation<->clone feed-forward loop (IL-6/TNF selecting mutant clones); (3) wiring CHIP output to the methylation layer's immune-aging / inflammation features and the Aging_inflammation and Aging_senescence_genomic sub-scores. Anchor edges are primary-verified; proposed edges (especially clonal dynamics) need your curation.
